runs.text: Price discrimination charges different buyers different prices for the same product when resale can be prevented. Preventing resale is what allows separated prices to persist. Different demand responsiveness is the economic reason separated groups can receive different optimal prices. Charging each unit up to willingness to pay can make serving all units with value at least MC profitable. Price discrimination requires control over price and a way to distinguish relevant buyers or markets.
